name: MangoFarmSol
rootCause: The MangoFarm project is suspected of a rug pull. The official Twitter account of the MangoFarm is no longer accessible.

descriptions.text: The MangoFarm project is suspected of a rug pull. The official Twitter account of the MangoFarm is no longer accessible.

MangoFarmSOL, a Solana yield farming project that promised a January 2024 token airdrop, drained user deposits on 2024-01-06 and then deployed a malicious “EmergencyMigration” frontend that stole additional user assets. Public reporting and linked transfer records indicate roughly 13,500 SOL was removed from project-controlled wallets before proceeds were bridged to Ethereum and laundered through Railgun, eXch, FixedFloat, Wormhole, and Allbridge. The incident was an exit scam by the project operators.
